IN THE NORTHERN DISTRICT COURT
Halvorsen v. Meridian Instruments Inc., 3:25-cv-01142

COMPLAINT (filed 4 November 2025)

1. Plaintiff is a former calibration technician employed by defendant.
2. Plaintiff alleges that defendant knowingly falsified calibration records for
   the RX-9 sensor between 2023 and 2025.
3. Plaintiff further alleges that defendant instructed staff to omit failing
   runs from the retained record.
4. Plaintiff seeks damages and injunctive relief.

Nothing in this filing has been adjudicated. The allegations are the
plaintiff's.
